name: Simple Recipe for Marmalade
description: Historical recipe from The Canadian Family Cook Book (1914). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Cut bitter oranges and one lemon very thin, and put into water
Let stand over night or thirty-six hours
Boil rather fast two and one-half hours
Add seven or eight pounds of white sugar and boil one hour longer
Take out all seeds and hard ends
If sweet oranges are used put in only the pulp
The addition of the pulp of two sweet oranges sometimes improves the marmalade

source.author: Grace E. Denison
source.originalInstructions:
1. Cut bitter oranges and one lemon very thin, and put into water
2. Let stand over night or thirty-six hours
3. Boil rather fast two and one-half hours
4. Add seven or eight pounds of white sugar and boil one hour longer
5. Take out all seeds and hard ends
6. If sweet oranges are used put in only the pulp
7. The addition of the pulp of two sweet oranges sometimes improves the marmalade
